native.music: Volume of background music and records, before master and per-track volume.
native.sound: Volume of game sounds, before master and category volume.
native.sensitivity: Mouse turning speed. 100 is Minecraft's standard sensitivity.
native.invert: Reverses vertical mouse movement when looking around.
native.bobbing: Moves the first-person camera as you walk.
native.anaglyph: Renders red/cyan stereo for anaglyph glasses.
native.opengl: Skips hidden geometry using GPU occlusion queries. Benefits depend on your graphics driver.
native.ao: Softens lighting across block corners instead of flat lighting per face.
native.difficulty: Controls hostile mobs and damage. Peaceful removes hostile mobs and restores health.
native.fov: Camera angle in degrees. Higher values show more scenery and make the player look smaller in third person.
native.brightness: Brighten dark areas. Beta bakes lighting into chunk geometry, so changing this rebuilds nearby chunks.
native.cloudHeight: Altitude of the cloud layer in blocks.
native.fogDensity: Amount of distance fog. 100 is normal; 0 removes it.
native.renderDistance: Maximum terrain draw distance in chunks. Higher values use more memory and processing time.
native.fpsLimit: Cap rendering at 5 to 1000 frames per second, or Unlimited. VSync can impose a lower limit.
native.guiScale: Resizes menus and the HUD immediately. Auto uses the largest scale that fits. The minimum menu size is 320 x 240, so larger scales may look identical in a small window.
native.clouds: Draws the cloud layer in the sky.
tweaks.flexible.enabled: Enables placement hotkeys for moving the target position and changing block orientation.
tweaks.flexible.showOverlay: Draws selectable placement regions on the targeted block face while a placement key is held.
tweaks.flexible.showPreview: Outlines the block position that the current placement keys would use.
tweaks.flexible.placeAgainstContainers: Allows placement against chests, furnaces and other interactive blocks while a placement key is held.
tweaks.flexible.overlayColor: Tint used for the placement regions and destination outline.
tweaks.flexible.overlayOpacity: Transparency of the placement preview. Higher values make it more visible.
tweaks.sneak.announceToggle: Shows a chat message when edge protection is switched on or off.
tweaks.slabs.enabled: Combines matching half slabs when clicking a neighboring face would place into the existing slab.
tweaks.slabs.announceToggle: Shows a chat message when adjacent-face slab completion is switched on or off.
tweaks.freeLookFollowThirdPerson: Keeps free look in third person when the camera is already in third person, even if First person is selected.
tweaks.autoWalk: Keeps walking forward without holding the movement key. Use its key binding to switch it off.
tweaks.freeLook: Lets the camera turn independently of the player's movement and placement direction.
tweaks.freeLookToggle: Hold requires keeping the free-look key down. Toggle stays active until the next press.
tweaks.freeLookPerspective: Selects the camera view used during free look. Following the current third-person view can override this.
tweaks.boatSteering: Steer boats directly using movement keys. Speed and collision protection are separate.
tweaks.fastMinecarts: Raises the minecart speed limit. Faster carts need longer braking distances.
worldedit.wandItem: Numeric item ID used for selecting corners. 271 is a wooden axe.
worldedit.wandEnabled: Left-click sets the first corner; right-click sets the second, while holding the wand.
worldedit.showSelection: Draws a box around the selected editing region.
worldedit.throughWalls: Keeps the selection outline visible behind solid blocks.
worldedit.opacity: Visibility of the selection box. Higher values make it less transparent.
worldedit.lineWidth: Thickness of selection edges in screen pixels.
power_capture:config.addBasicScreenshots: Copies normal screenshots to the system clipboard as well as saving the image file.
power_capture:config.customResolutionPho: Height of custom-resolution screenshots. Larger images take more memory and time.
Width of custom-resolution screenshots. Larger images take more memory and time.
power_capture:config.isometricPhotoScale: Resolution multiplier for isometric screenshots. Larger values produce bigger image files.
power_capture:config.isometricPhotoRotat: Compass orientation used for the isometric scene capture.
entityculling:config.disableEntityCullin: Skip drawing objects fully hidden behind solid blocks to improve frame rate.
entityculling:config.disableBlockEntityC: Skip drawing objects fully hidden behind solid blocks to improve frame rate.
entityculling:config.f3InfoYOffset: Moves culling statistics vertically in the debug overlay, in GUI pixels.
power_camera:config.collision: Stops the detached camera at solid blocks. Off allows flying through them.
power_hud:config.enableChatScroll: Allows the mouse wheel to browse older chat messages while chat is open.
power_hud:config.coordinateDisplay: Shows, hides or disguises coordinates in the debug overlay.
power_hud:config.disableCrosshair: Hides the aiming cross in the center of the screen.
power_hud:config.disableVignette: Darken the screen edges in dim areas.
power_hud:config.drawXboxXAndYButtons: Adds console-style X and Y button prompts to the HUD.
power_hud:config.enableHotbarItemSelecti: Briefly displays an item's name when selecting its hotbar slot.
power_inventory:config.MODERN_MINECRAFT_: Shift-clicking wearable armor equips it in an empty armor slot.
Shift-clicking sends fuel and smeltable items to the appropriate furnace slot.
Shows a preview of how the held stack will be divided while dragging over inventory slots.
Splits the held stack evenly across slots visited while holding the left mouse button.
Places one held item in each slot visited while holding the right mouse button.
With Shift held, prioritizes quick transfers over left-button stack distribution.
With Shift held, prioritizes quick transfers over right-button stack distribution.
Holding Left Ctrl with the drop key drops the selected stack instead of one item.
power_inventory:config.MOUSE_TWEAKS_CONF: Adds one item to compatible occupied slots as you drag the held stack over them.
Collects matching stacks while dragging with the left mouse button.
Firing arrows wears out bows instead of allowing unlimited use.
Makes armor durability independent of the material's usual base durability multiplier.
Uses material-dependent armor protection instead of Beta's durability-based protection.
power_mechanics:config.EXPLOSION_AND_FIR: Thrown snowballs put out fire where they land.
Burning removes the grass surface from affected grass blocks.
A reflected fireball kills the ghast it hits immediately.
Prevents all explosions from destroying terrain. Entity damage is unchanged.
Preserves terrain during creeper explosions. Entity damage is unchanged.
Preserves terrain during ghast fireball explosions. Entity damage is unchanged.
Stops ghast explosions from starting fires.
Preserves terrain during TNT explosions. Entity damage is unchanged.
power_mechanics:config.FLORA_CONFIG.enab: Breaking a dead bush with shears drops the plant itself.
Breaking tall grass with shears drops the plant itself.
power_mechanics:config.MOB_CONFIG.enable: Enables the configured extra zombie loot roll; item and chance are controlled separately.
Enables the configured extra zombie-pigman loot roll; item and chance are controlled separately.
power_client_fixes:config.enableAuthenti: Updates multiplayer session authentication for current login services. The bundled account service already handles this, so it normally stays off.
power_client_fixes:config.enableControls: Enables legacy mouse-button binding and control-screen fixes. The unified Controls page already replaces that screen.
power_client_fixes:config.enableChatChan: Adds editable chat text, navigation and message-history handling.
power_client_fixes:config.enableDebugGra: Makes the debug performance graph accessible through its key binding.
power_client_fixes:config.enableDebugMen: Shows the world seed in the debug overlay.
power_client_fixes:config.enableMultipla: Adds the saved server list and improved multiplayer connection screens.
power_client_fixes:config.enableSkinChan: Loads modern skin layouts and supports slim arms and additional skin layers.
power_client_fixes:config.enableWoodenSi: Adds improved text editing and character handling to signs.
power_client_fixes:config.USE_ALTERNATE_: Uses the alternate resource server instead of the primary URL below.
power_client_fixes:config.RESOURCES_DOWN: Primary server used to download missing legacy sounds and music.
power_client_fixes:config.ALTERNATE_RESO: Fallback server for legacy sounds and music, used when alternate downloads are selected.
power_client_fixes:config.renderCape: Shows capes when a player's skin service provides one.
power_client_fixes:config.raiseSlimSkinS: Adjusts slim-arm skin shoulders to match modern skin proportions.
power_environment:config.ENTITY_SPAWN_ME: Target population cap for naturally spawning hostile mobs. Does not limit existing or command-spawned mobs.
Target population cap for naturally spawning land animals.
Target population cap for naturally spawning water creatures.
power_environment:config.MUSIC_CONFIG.ov: Moves the current-track text vertically in the debug overlay, in GUI pixels.
power_environment:config.SLEEP_CONFIG.be: Time passes faster while sleeping instead of jumping directly to morning.
power_environment:config.SLEEP_CONFIG.ha: A mouse click wakes you without needing the Leave Bed button.
Makes precipitation fall as snow above the configured altitude, regardless of biome temperature.
Altitude in blocks above which the snow override applies.
Prevents thunderstorms while leaving ordinary rain available.
Keeps savanna biomes dry during rainy weather.
Sleeping preserves the clear-weather timer unless it is currently raining.
power_environment:config.ENABLE_SOUL_SAN: Adds a crafting recipe for soul sand.
power_environment:config.SOUL_SAND_OUTPU: Number of soul-sand blocks produced by one craft.
station-api-configuration:config.loading: Chooses the appearance and animation of the startup loading screen.
power_controls:bugfixes.farLandsJitterFi: Reduces visible shaking at very large world coordinates.
power_controls:bugfixes.leggingsWhenRidi: Corrects the leg armor position while riding vehicles or animals.
power_controls:bugfixes.armorIconsFix: Corrects armor-slot and armor-bar icon rendering.
power_controls:bugfixes.droppedItemSizeF: Corrects the render scale of dropped items.
power_controls:bugfixes.deathScreenForma: Repairs malformed formatting in death-screen text.
power_controls:features.fastLeafDecay.en: Makes unsupported leaves decay sooner after nearby logs are removed.
power_controls:features.fastLeafDecay.mi: Shortest scheduled leaf-decay delay, in game ticks. Must be below the maximum.
power_controls:features.fastLeafDecay.ma: Longest scheduled leaf-decay delay, in game ticks.
power_controls:features.betterBurning.sk: Allows burning skeletons to launch flaming arrows, using the chance below.
Percent chance that an arrow fired by a burning skeleton is alight.
power_controls:features.betterBurning.bu: Flaming arrows ignite the entities they hit.
Allows fire to spread when a burning entity attacks another entity.
Percent chance for fire to spread on a hit from a burning entity.
power_controls:gameplay.pickBlockFromInv: Middle-click selects a matching block already in your inventory.
power_controls:gameplay.rightClickEquipA: Using held armor equips it if its armor slot is empty.
power_controls:general.pauseOnLostFocus: Pauses singleplayer when the game window loses focus.
power_controls:general.autosaveInterval: Seconds between automatic world saves. Shorter intervals reduce progress lost after a crash.
power_controls:general.tcpNoDelay: Sends multiplayer packets without batching small messages, reducing network input latency.
power_controls:oldfeatures.disableDeadBu: Leaves dead bushes out of newly generated terrain. Existing bushes are unchanged.
power_controls:oldfeatures.disableTallGr: Leaves tall grass out of newly generated terrain. Existing plants are unchanged.
power_controls:oldfeatures.punchSheepFor: Restores the older behavior where hitting sheep releases wool without shears.
power_controls:oldfeatures.punchTntToIgn: Hitting TNT ignites it instead of breaking it as an item.
power_controls:oldfeatures.punchTntToDef: Hitting primed TNT stops its fuse and recovers it.
power_controls:oldfeatures.hoeGrassForSe: Restores seed drops when tilling grass blocks.
power_controls:oldfeatures.boatElevators: Restores boats rising through vertical water columns.
power_controls:oldfeatures.ladderGaps: Allows climbing through one-block gaps between ladders.
power_controls:oldfeatures.minecartBoost: Restores the old acceleration behavior of minecarts touching each other.
power_controls:recipes.furnaceFuels: Allows additional wooden items to be consumed as furnace fuel.
power_controls:recipes.toolRepair: Combines two damaged tools of the same type in the crafting grid to recover durability.
power_controls:recipes.modern.booksRequi: Adds leather to the book recipe, matching later Minecraft versions.
power_controls:recipes.modern.woolRedyei: Allows already-colored wool to be dyed again.
power_controls:recipes.modern.sixSlabsPe: Produces six slabs per recipe instead of Beta's three.
power_controls:recipes.modern.oneStonePe: Crafts a button from one stone instead of two.
power_controls:recipes.modern.modernFenc: Uses four planks and two sticks for fences instead of the Beta stick-only recipe.
power_controls:recipes.modern.snowLayerR: Adds a recipe for thin snow layers.
power_controls:recipes.modern.threeLadde: Produces three ladders per recipe instead of Beta's two.
power_controls:recipes.tweaked.stairsPer: Number of stairs produced from a six-block stair recipe.
power_controls:recipes.tweaked.trapdoors: Number of trapdoors produced by one recipe.
power_controls:tweaks.sugarCaneOnSand: Allows sugar cane to grow on sand beside water, as well as dirt and grass.
power_controls:tweaks.boatsDropThemselve: Recovers a boat item when a player breaks a boat, instead of planks and sticks.
power_controls:tweaks.boatsDontBreak: Keeps boats intact when they collide with solid blocks.
power_controls:tweaks.pumpkinsPlaceableL: Removes the special support restrictions for placing pumpkins.
power_controls:tweaks.fencesPlaceableLik: Removes Beta's extra placement restrictions on fences, including stacking.
power_controls:tweaks.fencesConnectBlock: Draws fence connections to adjacent solid blocks.
power_controls:tweaks.bookshelvesDropBoo: Breaking a bookshelf drops three books rather than nothing.
power_controls:tweaks.pressurePlatesOnFe: Allows pressure plates to be supported by fence posts.
power_controls:tweaks.shearHarvesting: Allows shears to harvest cobwebs and tall grass as items.
power_controls:tweaks.modernFlintAndStee: Only consumes durability when flint and steel successfully lights a fire.
power_controls:tweaks.disableSleeping: Beds still set a respawn point, but cannot skip the night.
power_controls:tweaks.disableSleepSpawni: Prevents hostile mobs from spawning beside a player sleeping in an unsafe bed.
power_controls:tweaks.preventItemsStoppi: Dropped items no longer obstruct moving minecarts.
power_controls:tweaks.allowIgnitingEntit: Using flint and steel on an entity sets it on fire.
power_controls:tweaks.allowTrapdoorsWith: Keeps trapdoors valid without an adjacent supporting block.
power_controls:tweaks.beta18LeavesRender: Uses later leaf-face rendering rules to reduce visible internal faces.
power_controls:userinterface.improvedCon: Enables the legacy enhanced controls screen. The unified Controls page takes precedence.
power_controls:userinterface.hideAchieve: Suppresses the popup shown when earning an achievement.
power_controls:userinterface.disableDebu: Hides numeric labels above entities in the debug view.
power_controls:userinterface.fovSlider: Enables the adjustable field-of-view option instead of the fixed vanilla angle.
power_controls:userinterface.videoSettin: Uses vanilla Far fog behavior at the corresponding render-distance setting.
power_controls:userinterface.versionText: Draws version text on the gameplay HUD.
Draws the historical unlicensed-copy notice on screen. It does not affect login or ownership.
Uses the custom version text instead of the normal version label.
power_controls:userinterface.panoramaCon: Uses a panoramic scene behind title-screen buttons instead of the dirt background.
Softens the panorama image behind the menu.
power_compat:config.PARTICLES_CONFIG.dis: Suppresses all particle effects. Individual particle switches have no effect while this is on.
power_compat:config.STACK_SIZE_CONFIG.en: Allows wooden doors to stack up to 64 instead of one per slot.
Allows iron doors to stack up to 64 instead of one per slot.
Allows signs to stack up to 16 instead of one per slot.
power_compat:config.SHOVELS_CONFIG.enabl: Makes shovels break soul sand faster than using a bare hand.
power_compat:config.addBiomeToDebugOverl: Shows the biome at the player's position in the debug view.
power_compat:config.addDayCounterToDebug: Shows the world's elapsed day count in the debug view.
power_compat:config.addTotalPlayTimeToDe: Shows time spent playing, in hours, in the debug view.
power_compat:config.addSlimeChunkToDebug: Indicates whether the current chunk can spawn slimes.
power_compat:config.overlayAdditionsYOff: Moves the additional debug text vertically, in GUI pixels.
power_compat:config.milkSquids: Allows an empty bucket to collect milk from a squid.
power_compat:config.pigsDropBrownMushroo: Adds brown mushrooms to pig drops.
power_compat:config.plantReplacementFixe: Lets block placement replace thin plants instead of always placing beside them.
power_compat:config.slabPlacementFixesEn: Enables the older slab placement adjustments. Adjacent-face slab completion has its own control.
power_compat:config.allowCraftingInvento: Retains items in the player's 2x2 crafting grid when closing the inventory.
power_compat:config.vehicleLogoutLoginFi: Restores the player's mounted vehicle correctly after saving and reloading.
